required_checks: Exact 62 registry decks, 62 blueprint files and 62 review packets, no extras or omissions
Each slug and deck ID matches each source; blueprint canonical hash, packet list hash and registry canonical hash agree
Packets contain review items with unique swap IDs, source provenance, no decision authority; re-count packet sources, priorities and scrutiny against declared packet counts
Blueprint commander centrality, dependency level, required identity cards, anti-goals, registered exceptions and future-release dates remain verbatim source fields not replaced by model judgments
For every proposed swap, flag loss of blueprint identity-core cards and membership of required commander blueprint packages; note high-risk packet flags and missing effects
Generate individual review routes with best *first-to-examine* candidates selected by source agreement / burden / named commander fit, not by raw popularity score or automated yes vote
Do not equate M5 exploratory paired goldfish test_pass with meaningful card effect, verified improvement, actual game win probability or full M6 Phase B
Respect official-vs-project exception distinction and preserve intentionally future-release cards as authorized project exceptions without classifying them as surprise errors
Produce ranked work *queue* and risk inventory across all 62, but NEVER automatically recommend a swap, certify no improvement, assert current official legality, or approve M6
All counts / queue must be deterministic and independently reproducible in CI and confined to new M6 plan, script, test and evidence

triage_rules.priority_for_first_human_review: Decks with >=1 independent P0 agreement hypothesis with no protected core cut, no elevated burden, no known test-fail, and no not-modelable flag are earlier opportunities to investigate, NOT preapproved swaps.
triage_rules.tie_breaker: Highest count of source-agreement low-triage-burden examples, then highest count of all P0 source-agreement items, then lowest count of compulsory high-scrutiny obligations, then deck slug alphabetical.
triage_rules.score_handling: Candidate screening scores, ranks and test pass are source metadata only. Do not sort by score to imply deck strength.
triage_rules.protected_cuts: Flag every cut that matches an identity_core card or any required blueprint package card; may be necessary but requires documented role compensation.
triage_rules.exception_handling: Keep known exception statuses separate from blocker counts; future release is explicitly authorized, not officially legal before its legal_from date.

abaddon_specific_evidence: Cycle 110 common-board comparison verdict CANNOT_EVALUATE; do not classify any Abaddon swap as strategically resolved.
limitations: No independent human/agent commander-strategy judgments issued by deterministic code.
Canonical deck approvals live in a DIFFERENT repo from the companion M6 SOURCE_BASELINE registry, and are checked independently by connector before/after CI.
No candidate is guaranteed legal or strategically optimal from this old Oracle snapshot or M5 screening.
Readiness tier is scheduling priority for manual/reviewer attention, not performance or deck quality ranking.
Full Pass C/I/J, 62 individual decision certificates, balanced game modeling, and M6 acceptance remain open.
